## Function Resolve Profile

The profile of a Component — its own language, else the map's, else typescript.

Behaviour: resolveProfile(componentLanguage, mapLanguage), both string | null. The choice is the component's value unless it is null or "", then the map's unless null or "", then "typescript". The key is the choice trimmed and lower-cased; the profile is the PROFILES entry whose id equals the key → {ok: true, profile} (the registry object itself). No entry → {ok: false, error: "unknown language '<the choice as given>' (known: typescript, python, go)"}, the known ids in PROFILES order. PROFILES is the registry, typescript, python, then go, each profile exactly the content of its fixture tests/fixtures/language/<id>.json.

## Function Fill Template

Replaces every {key} of a profile template with its value, literally, in one pass.

Behaviour: fillTemplate(template, values: Record<string, string>) replaces every occurrence of "{<key>}" (key = letters only) whose key is an own property of values with that value, taken literally ("$&", "$1" are not replacement patterns), in a single pass (a value that itself holds "{x}" is not expanded again). A placeholder whose key is not in values stays as it is.

Steps:
- produces: string

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given template "tests/{component}/{name}.test.ts", values {component: "cli", name: "parseCommand"}; when filled; then "tests/cli/parseCommand.test.ts"
2. given template "{a}-{a}-{c}", values {a: "$&"}; when filled; then "$&-$&-{c}" — every occurrence, the value literal, an unknown key kept
3. given template "{a}{b}", values {a: "{b}", b: "x"}; when filled; then "{b}x" — one pass, a value is not expanded again

## Function Build Acceptances

Sets the acceptance of every card the checks name, from its generation's siblings and the texts read.

Behaviour: buildAcceptances({cards, checks, profile, texts}). A profile other than typescript and go → {ok: false, errors: ["no acceptance builder for language '<id>' (only typescript, go)"]}. Else the errors, in this order: the guard, then the locator, holding any of the six heredoc tags (HEREDOC_TAGS: MORPH_GUARD_EOF, MORPH_CONF_EOF, MORPH_TSCONF_EOF, MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF, MORPH_PROBE_EOF, MORPH_LITS_EOF) → "the guard holds the heredoc tag <tag>" / "the first-difference locator holds …", one per tag; then per checks card in order: no card of that id → "checks card '<id>' is not in the deck" (nothing more on it); no target with an extension of the profile → "card '<id>' has no <profile id> target" (a wrong profile is refused, never built); a judge (files not null) whose file paths are not exactly its targets → "judge '<id>': files <JSON of the paths> are not its targets <JSON of the targets>"; a code card without texts.probes[id] → "code card '<id>' has no probe", a probe holding a tag → "the probe of <id> holds the heredoc tag <tag>"; smoke null with a test target → "code card '<id>' targets the test <test> but has no smoke cap"; smoke with no test target → "code card '<id>' has a smoke cap but no test target". Any error → {ok: false, errors}. The members are the named cards in the checks' order; their generations are Layer Generations of the members alone (a dependency outside them is ignored); a member's siblings are the targets of the other members of its generation, in the checks' order. Each member gets Code Acceptance or Judge Acceptance — with the go profile builder-go's goCodeAcceptance or goJudgeAcceptance, same arguments — with ctx {id, phase, targets, siblings, frozen, fullExclude, ownGit, profile, guard, firstdiff}. → {ok: true, cards}: the input cards in their order, each member a copy with its acceptance, every other card as given. probeFile(profile, id) (exported; cli reads the probe by it) = "_<id>_probe_test.go" for the go profile (the leading "_" makes the go tool ignore the file where it is kept, decks/<phase>/parts), else "<id>.probe.ts".
